label: E1: equal-weight ensemble of the five v1.0 tied arms

compute.notes: No training: the five members are the registered v1.0 arms, unchanged. Dev + sim-val evaluation 11 CPU-min.

feature_engineering: None of its own: each member reads the batch as in round 1. Combination per target day, weights 1/5: mean of the members' means; each quantile = mean of the members' same quantile, then sorted.
compare_note: seq_lstm is the best member on dev (0.4408), fixed before the exam (STATUS.md 23:54); flowcast_v1 is an anchor for every arm
rule: PREREG section 5: registered if dev median NSE >= 0.95 x the best member's dev median NSE; 'ensembling helps on dev' only if > best member + 0.01

rungs.change: equal-weight mean of tab_gbm, flowcast_v1, seq_lstm, seq_tcn, seq_ssm (quantile averaging)
rungs.why: dev 0.445 >= 0.95 x 0.441 (best member seq_lstm): gate passes. +0.004 over the best member (paired bootstrap -0.026..+0.025, tie): no claim that ensembling helps on dev.
